import os import hashlib from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, send_file, render_template_string app = Flask(__name__) PLUGIN_WORKSPACE = '/var/lib/ci-runner/workspaces' ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ['.log', '.txt', '.xml', '.json', '.html'] def compute_artifact_hash(filepath): """Compute SHA256 hash for artifact integrity verification.""" sha256 = hashlib.sha256() with open(filepath, 'rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(4096), b''): sha256.update(chunk) return sha256.hexdigest() def validate_extension(filename): """Check if file extension is in allowed list.""" _, ext = os.path.splitext(filename) return ext.lower() in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS @app.route('/api/v1/pipeline//artifacts', methods=['GET']) def get_artifact(pipeline_id): """Retrieve build artifacts from pipeline workspace.""" artifact_path = request.args.get('path', '') # Basic sanitization - remove null bytes artifact_path = artifact_path.replace('\x00', '') # Construct full path using workspace root workspace_dir = os.path.join(PLUGIN_WORKSPACE, pipeline_id) full_path = os.path.join(workspace_dir, artifact_path) # Extension validation if not validate_extension(full_path): return jsonify({'error': 'File type not allowed'}), 403 # Check file exists if not os.path.isfile(full_path): return jsonify({'error': 'Artifact not found'}), 404 file_hash = compute_artifact_hash(full_path) return send_file(full_path, as_attachment=False) @app.route('/api/v1/pipeline//report', methods=['GET']) def get_report(pipeline_id): """Render HTML test report with embedded results.""" report_file = request.args.get('file', 'report.html') # Sanitize - strip leading slashes and null bytes report_file = report_file.lstrip('/').replace('\x00', '') workspace_dir = os.path.join(PLUGIN_WORKSPACE, pipeline_id) report_path = os.path.join(workspace_dir, 'reports', report_file) if not os.path.isfile(report_path): return jsonify({'error': 'Report not found'}), 404 with open(report_path, 'r') as f: content = f.read() # Render the report content directly - allows custom HTML reports template = f""" Pipeline Report - {pipeline_id}
{content}
""" return render_template_string(template) @app.route('/api/v1/pipeline//config', methods=['GET']) def get_config(pipeline_id): """Read pipeline configuration file.""" config_name = request.args.get('name', 'pipeline.json') # Only allow .json and .yaml configs if not config_name.endswith(('.json', '.yaml', '.yml')): return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid config format'}), 400 config_path = os.path.join(PLUGIN_WORKSPACE, pipeline_id, config_name) if not os.path.isfile(config_path): return jsonify({'error': 'Config not found'}), 404 with open(config_path, 'r') as f: return f.read(), 200, {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)

environment.description: Same CI/CD runner container deployed on EKS with an Istio service mesh sidecar (v1.20). The Envoy proxy has a Lua filter that applies response header manipulation via EnvoyFilter CRD. Specifically, the mesh-wide EnvoyFilter resource 'ci-response-hardening' patches the HTTP_FILTER chain to inject a Lua script on all responses from the ci-runner workload that sets Content-Security-Policy to "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'" and additionally sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. The container also runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in the pod securityContext) with an emptyDir volume mounted exclusively at /var/lib/ci-runner/workspaces — meaning path traversal beyond the emptyDir mount point reaches only the read-only container filesystem layers. The Kubernetes SecurityContext also sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and runAsNonRoot: true (uid 1000).

config.runtime: EKS 1.28, containerd, Istio 1.20 sidecar injection enabled
config.envoy_filter: ci-response-hardening EnvoyFilter CRD, Lua HTTP filter, response header injection
config.csp_header: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
